    1. Trano
    2. Validation

    Systems validation

    Do the heating and ventilation systems trano generates behave as the real ones do? Each case below puts one system on the same 100 m2 zone (filled cavity walls, insulated roof and slab, 10 m2 of low-e double glazing facing south, n50 = 3, occupied from 7 to 19 h, heated to 21 degC from 7 to 22 h and 16 degC at night) for one week of the Uccle weather, and is simulated with Buildings, IDEAS and FastSmoothBuildings. The KPIs are read from the result files by validation/systems/kpi.py; the band of every KPI and the physical reasoning behind it are in validation/systems/expected.yaml; pytest -m systems fails when a KPI leaves its band. The tables are rendered from the last results with python -m validation.systems report --docs.

    Heat pump
